title: Telehealth Interpretation for Clinical Teams
summary: Set up telehealth interpretation for Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, EHR workflows, audio quality, security, and clinical follow-up. (October 2026)
body_markdown:
###


Choose whether the interpreter will join the meeting or the interpretation workflow will run alongside it. Test microphone and speaker selection, participant admission, echo, and the patient's joining path. Use a stable network and document a phone backup before clinical discussion begins. Opalite can use SSO or SAML, and retention is configured to the organization's policy rather than one universal default.


###


Confirm preferred language and device before the visit, start the interpreter before the clinical history, identify everyone on the call, use one speaker at a time, and pause for medications and numbers. If audio fails, stop the clinical discussion, restore interpretation, and repeat the last important turn.


###


Opalite supports EHR and telehealth integration, but the launch point and data flow are configured for each customer. Where supported, EHR connections use SMART on FHIR and OAuth 2.0 with customer-scoped access. Epic, athenahealth, proprietary platforms, and ambient scribe workflows require workflow review, sandbox testing, security approval, and validation before rollout.


###


Guardian checks every interpreted turn for potential meaning changes, medical terminology issues, low-confidence output, hallucinated content, and numerical inconsistencies. Opalite's blinded validation covers Spanish, Mandarin, and Cantonese only. Organizations should test other priority languages and dialects with realistic clinical content and appropriate reviewers.


###


Transcript and note generation depends on the configured workflow. Access is customer-scoped, role-based, and audit-logged, and retention follows the organization's policy, including minimal-retention options. Delivery to an EHR or third-party analytics system requires a reviewed and approved integration. This page does not claim compatibility with RingSense or another specific analytics product.
